description: Claim lease / lastProgress design: stale claim classification fixture. Covers claimedAt/lastProgressAt detection, nonterminal claimed-missing-evidence (Daegyo-style), and normal fresh-claim with progress. Source-only/no-live; does not mutate live broker/DB/workers.

v0Freeze.note: Stale claim detection is contract-only; no live broker/DB mutation. Default staleClaimThresholdMs is 300000 (5 minutes).

fresh_claim.description: Task was claimed recently with no lastProgressAt; worker may still be starting.

stale_claim_no_progress.description: Task was claimed but no lastProgressAt posted past the threshold. Worker may be stuck or not processing. Finalizer should record as nonterminal_missing_evidence and consider cancel/retry.

stale_claim_last_progress_present.staleDeltaMs: claimedAt > staleClaimThresholdMs but lastProgressAt within threshold
stale_claim_last_progress_present.description: Task was claimed long ago but lastProgressAt is recent; worker is making progress. Do not classify as stale.

nonterminal_claimed_missing_evidence.description: Task remains claimed past bounded poll with no terminal result/error. Daegyo-style failure mode. Finalizer must exclude from quorum and record as missing evidence.

nonterminal_running_missing_evidence.description: Task was started but no terminal result or lastProgress within threshold. Finalizer should exclude from quorum.

scenarios.name: fresh-claim-within-threshold
scenarios.description: Task just claimed, within threshold, no lastProgressAt yet.

scenarios.name: stale-claim-no-progress-past-threshold
scenarios.description: Task claimed long past threshold with no lastProgressAt. Daegyo-style claimed-stuck pattern.

scenarios.name: claim-old-but-last-progress-recent
scenarios.description: Task claimed long ago but lastProgressAt is recent. Worker is making progress.

scenarios.name: nonterminal-claimed-missing-evidence-daegyo
scenarios.description: Daegyo-style: task claimed through bounded poll, online worker heartbeat, no terminal result. Refs #985.

then.reason: Worker daegyo claimed task at 02:12Z but through poll end at 02:42Z (30 min) no terminal result posted despite online heartbeat.

scenarios.name: running-no-progress-stale
scenarios.description: Task started but no terminal result or lastProgress within threshold.

scenarios.name: running-with-recent-progress-not-stale
scenarios.description: Task started long ago but lastProgressAt is recent. Not stale.

finalizerAssertions: ClaimedAt must be present for every claimed task for classification to work.
LastProgressAt, when present, resets the stale clock even if claimedAt is old.
Nonterminal claimed tasks with stale claim with no progress must not count as substantive evidence.
Finalizer must record nonterminal_claimed_missing_evidence for tasks past bounded poll with no result.
Online worker heartbeat does not excuse missing terminal result; finalizer still excludes from quorum.
Stale claim classification is a finalizer-only evidence contract; workers must not self-classify.
